# DreamLand MUD

> DreamLand is a free text-based multiplayer fantasy game (a MUD) running since 1998. It is dark, funny and a little postmodern. It plays in a web browser or any telnet client, the whole game is available in English, Ukrainian and Russian, and it is built to work with screen readers: about 30% of its players are blind.

- Play in the browser: https://dreamland.rocks/play/
- Telnet: dreamland.rocks port 9000
- Free to play. No pay-for-power.
- Open source: https://github.com/dreamland-mud
- Origins: forked from Anatolia MUD (DikuMUD / Merc / ROM lineage). Started in Ukraine, still run by Ukrainian developers.

## The game

- 158 areas, about 9,800 rooms, 3,700 creatures, 5,600 objects.
- 13 classes, 23 playable races, 22 gods and 22 cults, 10 clans with their own skills, 14 hometowns.
- Crafting: blacksmith, carpenter, jeweler and tattooist trades, forges, mining.
- 56 hand-built area quests plus automatic personal quests.
- Randomly generated weapons, a gear advisor NPC, remort after level 100 with hero gear kept.
- Restricted PK, roleplay encouraged, newbie friendly. Adult content: 18+.

## How it is built

- Most spells, skills, quests and NPC behaviour run on Fenia, the game's own scripting language. Builders change the live world without a reboot.
- Every player picks English, Ukrainian or Russian at login. Room descriptions are 99.7% translated.
- Screen-reader mode (`config screenreader on`) replaces every visual element with linear text.
- The web client has a live graph map with click-to-walk, side panels and a phone layout.
- No LLM runs in the game. "AI" here means mob behaviour and combat AI.
